# nootropic.fm

> Self-learning 48 kHz WebAudio psychoacoustic AI exploring how the human mind reacts to peer-reviewed sound studies—mapping how you feel now to where you want to arrive, measuring objective cognitive outcomes, and continuously learning how to tune you to peak performance. Engineered exclusively for in-ear buds.

nootropic.fm (`app.nootropic.fm`) runs client-side 48 kHz AudioWorklet DSP (`~$0` marginal compute) driven by a closed-loop Bayesian Thompson Sampling Research Brain, paired with the **NOOTROPIC FM SOUND SYSTEMS** hardware roadmap (`www.nootropic.fm`). Intended for cognitive wellness, deep work, flow state, stress down-regulation, sleep wind-down, and daytime road alertness in adults 18+. Not a medical device; not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

## Core Documentation
- [Full Technical & Scientific Reference](https://www.nootropic.fm/llms-full.txt): Complete DSP specifications, NootropicFM Signature Mode, peer-reviewed DOI citations, Research Brain telemetry, In-Ear Buds physics rationale, hardware roadmap, and pricing.
- [Hardware & Brand Showcase (www.nootropic.fm)](https://www.nootropic.fm/): NOOTROPIC FM SOUND SYSTEMS hardware lineup (Orbital Phase-Ring Earbuds 01, Earbuds Pro PPG HRV, Sound System 01), 30-second interactive in-ear proof, and pricing.
- [Strategic R&D Sponsorship & Partners](https://www.nootropic.fm/partners/): Non-dilutive cognitive wellness cohort sponsorships, R&D fast-grants, and global hardware/audio partner overview.
- [Audio Studio Web App (app.nootropic.fm)](https://app.nootropic.fm/): Live interactive 48 kHz psychoacoustic studio, Study Lab, and Research Brain.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nootropic.fm/privacy/): Zero-tracker, opt-in EEA/UK/CH privacy architecture and passwordless Neural Sync Pass details.
- [Terms & Wellness Disclaimer](https://www.nootropic.fm/terms/): General wellness positioning, safe listening limits, and Driving Safety Mode boundaries.

## Key Capabilities
- **Dual-Layer 48 kHz WebAudio Engine**: Layer 1 scientific entrainment (`40 Hz` Gamma-MBI, 3-Band Linkwitz-Riley LR4 `190–4,500 Hz` cortical amplitude modulation, `0.10 Hz` HRV paced breathing, `600 Hz` Huggins dichotic headphone verification, ITU-R BS.1770-4 dynamic SNR follower) fused live into Layer 2 music.
- **NootropicFM Signature Mode (`6×40 Hz`)**: Standalone flagship protocol locking `6 Hz` Theta × `40 Hz` Gamma Cross-Frequency Coupling onto `120.000 BPM` phase-aligned sub-harmonic stems with a `0.10 Hz` Mayer-wave spatial orbit (zero sham dilution).
- **10 Studio Mix Genres + Endless Stream**: Remastered `-15.5 LUFS` stems, real-time procedural synthesis, Google Lyria RealTime infinite streaming, Circadian Daylight/Night modes, and R2-cached Studio Voice Concierge with sidechain ducking.
- **Research Brain (Closed-Loop Optimization)**: Hierarchical Thompson Sampling across user context, pre/post Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT reaction time ms & lapses), 15s motor tapping CV, Web Bluetooth HRV (RMSSD / LF ratio), and 25% blind Aperiodic Acoustic Sham controls on consented sessions.
- **NOOTROPIC FM SOUND SYSTEMS**: `Earbuds 01` (Wired USB-C 24-bit/48 kHz lossless reference IEM waitlist), `Earbuds Pro` (wireless LC3 + in-ear optical PPG HRV planned), and `Sound System 01` (nearfield crosstalk-canceled circadian desk/sleep system planned).
